CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "organizations" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "server_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "server_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "org_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "title" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "server_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL
)

localReadModels.name: taskCountsByProjectOwnerCompletion
setupSql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "syncular_rust_task_counts" (
  "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "task_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY ("project_id", "owner_id", "completed")
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS "syncular_rm_taskCountsByProjectOwnerCompletion_insert"
AFTER INSERT ON "tasks"
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO "syncular_rust_task_counts" ("project_id", "owner_id", "completed", "task_count")
  VALUES (new."project_id", new."owner_id", new."completed", 1)
  ON CONFLICT("project_id", "owner_id", "completed") DO UPDATE SET
    "task_count" = "task_count" + 1;
END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS "syncular_rm_taskCountsByProjectOwnerCompletion_delete"
AFTER DELETE ON "tasks"
BEGIN
  UPDATE "syncular_rust_task_counts"
  SET "task_count" = "task_count" - 1
  WHERE "project_id" = old."project_id"
          AND "owner_id" = old."owner_id"
          AND "completed" = old."completed";
  DELETE FROM "syncular_rust_task_counts" WHERE "task_count" <= 0;
END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS "syncular_rm_taskCountsByProjectOwnerCompletion_update_group"
AFTER UPDATE OF "project_id", "owner_id", "completed" ON "tasks"
WHEN old."project_id" IS NOT new."project_id"
        OR old."owner_id" IS NOT new."owner_id"
        OR old."completed" IS NOT new."completed"
BEGIN
  UPDATE "syncular_rust_task_counts"
  SET "task_count" = "task_count" - 1
  WHERE "project_id" = old."project_id"
          AND "owner_id" = old."owner_id"
          AND "completed" = old."completed";
  DELETE FROM "syncular_rust_task_counts" WHERE "task_count" <= 0;
  INSERT INTO "syncular_rust_task_counts" ("project_id", "owner_id", "completed", "task_count")
  VALUES (new."project_id", new."owner_id", new."completed", 1)
  ON CONFLICT("project_id", "owner_id", "completed") DO UPDATE SET
    "task_count" = "task_count" + 1;
END
rebuildSql:
INSERT INTO "syncular_rust_task_counts" ("project_id", "owner_id", "completed", "task_count")
SELECT "project_id", "owner_id", "completed", count(*)
FROM "tasks"
GROUP BY "project_id", "owner_id", "completed"
